baseline_report.immutable_interpretation: All original V6 nulls and gates remain frozen and must be reported.

global_rules.confirmation_qualification: Split reuse after related V6 outcomes were inspected; informative held-out intervention results, but not pristine prospective confirmation.

full_commit_to_targeted_query.reason: The prospectively generated V6 native-loop shards already contain the Native-report full_donor_patch, self_patch, count_subspace_transplant and norm_matched_orthogonal_patch arms; the first V6 analyzer omitted the full-state registered contrast.

targeted_next_city_continuous_readout.banks: reuse each cell's selected frozen K and three frozen random controls
targeted_next_city_continuous_readout.anchor_selection: deterministic diverse primary-anchor subset, at most one anchor per source seed before any repeat
targeted_next_city_continuous_readout.strong_gate: both seed-bootstrap 95% confidence-interval lower bounds exceed zero
targeted_next_city_continuous_readout.motivation: The original binary free-generation failure endpoint is ceiling-limited in both Index cells and cannot detect sub-threshold likelihood changes.

bullet_gemma_decode_aligned_carrier.diagnostic_positions: all teacher-forced positions from the registered targeted query through the final grammar carrier token, inclusive
bullet_gemma_decode_aligned_carrier.restoration_outcome: selected-mask boundary distance minus selected-mask plus clean-carrier-clamp boundary distance
bullet_gemma_decode_aligned_carrier.motivation: The binary K2 behavior arm keeps the bank off on every cached decode step, while the original carrier assay zeroed one query token only.

bullet_local_terminal_bridge.background: keep all earlier trace items clean and replace only the terminal item with the frozen same-length ordinary-token control
bullet_local_terminal_bridge.strong_gate: all three seed-bootstrap 95% confidence-interval lower bounds exceed zero
bullet_local_terminal_bridge.motivation: The original Bullet sufficiency arm restored one item into an otherwise globally uninformative and grammatically incoherent trace; local mediation tests the token-to-state arrow without that global-sufficiency requirement.

ncc_geometry.interpretation: NCC asks whether the intervention moves states along one discovery-fitted linear count-centroid geometry. The Native report does not establish a unified linear counter geometry, so these nulls are retained as limits rather than treated as implementation failures.
